rationale: The stock has surged ~10% in two consecutive 1-minute candles on massive volume (nearly 2M shares in two minutes) with no identifiable news catalyst, placing price at 100% of the intraday range in a parabolic fashion. Without a known catalyst, the move could represent M&A (making a short dangerous) or a washout spike (making a long dangerous at the high), so the risk/reward is unquantifiable in either direction. Skipping preserves capital and avoids chasing an extended, mystery-driven move.
